description: Data-center share of national (or regional) electricity consumption, realized/measured where available. Comparable only loosely: definitions (colocation/hyperscale vs enterprise), metering basis and denominators differ.

points.basis: Metered electricity consumption (CSO identifies data-centre meters by operator name, industry reports, high-consumption checks)
points.source: Central Statistics Office (CSO), Data Centres Metered Electricity Consumption 2025, released 7 July 2026
points.note: Data centres 23% vs all urban households 18% and rural households 9%. DC use +10% in 2025 vs +2% for all other users.

points.basis: Electricity supplied to ~200 data centres (CBS); ~50 sites >=10 GWh/yr use ~90%. Excludes in-house DCs of universities/hospitals (est. 142 GWh).
points.source: Statistics Netherlands (CBS), news release 18 Nov 2026 (2025 provisional)

points.basis: Eurostat services energy consumption (data centres), as compiled by CBS
points.source: CBS (18 Nov 2026) citing Eurostat nrg_d_serq_n and nrg_cb_e

points.basis: Eurostat; no data for Denmark, Italy, Luxembourg, Bulgaria, Croatia, Malta, Serbia
Meter-level grid consumption of 2,423 matched colocation/managed-hosting/hyperscale sites; excludes enterprise DCs. Official Statistics in Development.
points.method_gap: NESO capacity-based estimate for 2023 = 7.6 TWh vs DESNZ meter-based 4.1 TWh
points.source: DESNZ Energy Trends special article, 30 June 2026: Data centre electricity consumption in Great Britain, 2020-2024

points.basis: Government statement; reference year not stated (speech of 30 May 2024)
points.source: MDDI, Opening remarks by SMS Janil Puthucheary at ATxSummit Digital Sustainability Forum, 30 May 2024
points.note: Secondary reports (Eco-Business) put 2024 at ~6.5 TWh, roughly 11% of ~58 TWh national use: UNVERIFIED.

points.basis: Industry association claim (Danish Data Center Industry, DDI), year not stated; no official realized figure found (Eurostat has no Danish DC data)
points.source: DDI report (industry/advocacy) via search snippet; Danish Energy Agency AF25 projects 6.0 TWh in 2030, 26.8 TWh in 2040

points.basis: LBNL bottom-up model (excludes crypto). EPRI 2026: 177-192 TWh incl. crypto, 4-5%.
points.source: LBNL, US Data Center Energy Usage Report: 2025 Update (June 2026)

points.basis: EPRI state estimate; Dominion reports data centers = 28% of Virginia Power sales in 2025
points.source: EPRI Powering Intelligence (2024), Table A1; Dominion 2025 10-K

points.basis: IEA: "data centre electricity demand grew by almost 20% in 2025"
points.source: IEA, Key questions on energy and AI (slides, 11 June 2026, hosted by ADB Asia Clean Energy Forum)
points.note: IEA Energy and AI (Apr 2025) global ~415 TWh in 2024 (~1.5% of world electricity), US ~45% of it; 2025 ~485 TWh per IEA update: UNVERIFIED (iea.org blocked automated access).
